 HONOR Play 20A arrives on Shopee this 11.11 for as low as Php 45 a day
 by Ian Fuentes 
 - November 11, 2026 
 HONOR Philippines brings the HONOR Play 20A to Shopee today, November 11, as part of the 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale, with a special price of Php 8,099, exclusive vouchers, free shipping, and 0% interest installment options.
 The smartphone comes with a discounted price of Php 8,099, down from its Php 8,999 suggested retail price (SRP). Customers can also get the device for as low as Php 45 per day for six months through SPayLater at 0% interest.
 Designed for everyday convenience and entertainment, the HONOR Play 20A features an interactive 2-inch Smart Rear Screen that allows users to check notifications, control media playback, and take selfies using the rear camera. It also has a 6.9-inch display with a 90Hz refresh rate and a 6,000 mAh battery.
 “We want to make the HONOR Play 20A more accessible to Filipino consumers while giving them more ways to enjoy its features,” said Stephen Cheng, vice president of HONOR Philippines.
 HONOR Play 20A 11.11 Shopee deals
 Shoppers can purchase the HONOR Play 20A for Php 8,099 on Shopee, with an additional 20% Mega Discount Voucher and free shipping. Buyers who prefer installment payments can avail of the device for as low as Php 45 per day for six months at 0% interest through SPayLater.
 Shopee Live sessions will also feature exclusive discounts, vouchers, and freebies. James Afante will appear on November 10 at 12 noon, while Kris Aquino and Bimby Aquino will be featured at 6 PM on the same day.
 The HONOR Play 20A will be available exclusively on Shopee for early online access on November 11, ahead of its official launch and nationwide availability on November 28, 2026.
